description: The bar chart presents Token Ratio (TR) values for three language models across six evaluation categories, illustrating model performance per dataset and an overall average. The horizontal axis contains the categorical labels PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG in that left-to-right order, while the vertical axis represents TR on a linear scale from 0.0 to 1.0 with evenly spaced tick marks at 0.1 intervals. Each category shows a grouped set of three vertical bars: a dark purple bar for “RedWhale (our),” a light blue bar for “EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0,” and a light gray bar for “SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base),” with numeric value labels above each bar. For PT-EVAL, the bars are approximately 0.42 (RedWhale), 0.46 (EEVE), and 1.00 (SOLAR); for KoBEST-BQ they are about 0.52, 0.56, and 1.00; for KoBEST-CP about 0.71, 0.74, and 1.00; for KoBEST-HS about 0.50, 0.54, and 1.00; for KoBEST-SN about 0.69, 0.73, and 1.00; and for AVG about 0.57, 0.61, and 1.00. The bars are not shown as sorted by magnitude, and no special visual emphasis beyond consistent coloring and the value annotations is indicated.
caption_used: The bar chart illustrates the Token Ratio (TR) performance of three models across six categories: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG. The vertical axis ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick intervals of 0.1. Each category contains three bars representing RedWhale (our), EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base), respectively. Notably, SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 consistently outperforms the other models across all categories, achieving a perfect score of 1.00 in each case. RedWhale demonstrates a steady improvement across the datasets, with its highest performance observed in KoBEST-SN (approximately 0.73). In contrast, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 shows a decline in performance from KoBEST-BQ to KoBEST-HS, where it achieves its lowest score of 0.50. On average, RedWhale slightly surpasses EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, with a mean score of 0.61 compared to 0.57.
